Reliable notes:
- Level 1 layout: top 9-bordered room, middle 6-bordered room on the central connector, and bottom 15-bordered room.
- Reset restores a clean Level 1 baseline with the isolated visible 6 in the top room, top room interior empty, connector inactive, middle 6-bordered room empty, and bottom 15 room present.
- Important correction: the many 6s in the middle room are mostly border tiles, not the focus marker. The isolated 6 in the top 9-bordered room is the visible focus cue.
- Historical top-focused select changed visible top/connector states including 12, 10, 8, and 15. In older runs one sequence included 12->8->15; another showed 12->10, so 12 is contextual.
- Top=10 behaved like an uninformative/locked visible state in at least one older context: select, up, down, left, and right showed no visible change.
- Later remap attempts showed even apparent clean-baseline left/right/select/down/up could all be visually inert, so visible appearance may hide different history/context.
- New hidden-context path after fresh reset: immediate down from the apparent clean baseline showed no visible change, but then select changed the middle 6-bordered room interior to 10 while the isolated visible 6 still stayed in the top room. So hidden focus/context can shift to the middle even when down shows no visible grid change.
- Then select from middle=10 changed top room interior and the vertical connector to 12 while middle stayed 10.
- Another select changed that to an all-10 vertical chain: top=10, connector=10, middle=10.
- Then select from the all-10 vertical chain activated the bottom 15-bordered room with a 10 pattern inside while top/middle stayed 10.
- Another select from that bottom-10-active state appeared to toggle back to the all-10 chain, and undo appeared to restore the bottom-10-active state. So select can toggle between all-10-chain and bottom-active.
- Recent probes from the apparent bottom-10-active state became inconsistent/inert (down, left, right, select), reinforcing hidden history matters.
- Fresh-history retry had produced visible state top=10, connector=10, middle=12, bottom inactive. Up from that state appeared to return to the clean baseline-looking screen.
- Current recovery plan: use reset to guarantee fresh history, then test down immediately; if down still shows no visible change, try select next to test for the hidden shift into the middle=10 branch.
- Latest confirmation: after the newest reset, down again left the grid baseline-looking, and one follow-up select also appeared visually inert. Best next probe: repeat select in case the first select shifted hidden context without a visible change.
- Level 2 layout: (1) large top room with 10 outer frame and 9 inner border; (2) small middle room on the central vertical connector with 11 border; (3) lower row of three 10-framed boxes connected by 3s.
- Level 2 mapping so far: reset baseline, left seemed to move visible 6 to middle 11 room, up moved 6 to large top room, top select filled top with 12 and connector below with 12; repeated select/down/left/right then looked locked/no-op.

Map: top-left initially had three 3x3 8 blocks; later two, sometimes only the leftmost. Central stack has large top chamber (9 border), downstream small 13 chamber in L2, joined by a vertical connector that changes from 3 to active colors. Visible 6 markers can persist, so shown 6s are not always the active cursor.

Movement/cursor: likely traverses top/middle/lower/projected nodes; some moves are visually silent. Earlier confirmed: down from plain top moved to lower plain. Up from lower plain often seemed silent and may move toward middle.

Top cycle: on visible top center, repeated select cycled top+connector 12 -> 10 -> 8 -> 15 -> plain/reset-like. In 10-state, downstream projections often appear; 8/15 often clear. Up on visible top 15 once seemed to step backward to 8.

Middle/hidden-middle: hidden-middle select can reactivate network. With top/connector at 8, middle-related select changed middle independently and could project downstream patterns.

Important earlier correction: when board showed upper chamber+connector = 15, lower plain 15, and visible 6 in middle center, select changed upper chamber+connector to 12 while middle stayed plain/visible.

L2 notes: visible middle-15 can produce a large upper 10-frame plus downstream substructures. A bottom projected trio of small 10-boxes can appear. Left/right probes there were ambiguous because persistent lower 6s may remain while hidden movement occurs.

Recent L2 chain: selecting from projected-state display left the large upper frame in a 10-family active display while downstream structures stayed present. Selecting from the small 13 state appeared to fill its interior with 10 while the upper 10-family display persisted. Selecting the center node of the bottom projected trio seemed to fill the trio center 10-box and reveal side-node 6s. After moving left and selecting on the left projected side node, the trio collapsed and the board changed to an upstream feedback-style state, making the small 13 center a strong active candidate.

Current correction: after probing that small-13 candidate, the board appears to have returned to the plain large upper 10-family display with an upper-center 6 and the small 13 chamber plain again. Best next probe: down from this upper-10 display to test re-entry into the downstream branch.

L1 pattern: select cycled the top stage 12 -> 10 -> 8; select at 8 transferred control downward; completed stages turned to 15. After arming the lower stage, select/down in the small bottom 15 chamber advanced to Level 2. Reset from L2 sends us back to Level 1 while the lower chamber remains 15; select on the top stage resumes the same cycle. After select at 8, L1 can enter a transfer/downstream mode: upper completed 15 room with center 6, long 15 shaft, lower active room that also cycles 10 -> 8 under select, and a still-lower 15 chamber. Selecting in the lower 8-room can return to Level 2.
L2 observations: top inner 9 room inside outer 10 frame with long vertical 3 shaft leading toward lower boxes. From the top room, left/select caused no visible change; down also caused no visible change on retest. Right often/reliably transferred or activated a lower 10-box (likely lower-left), though some repeats were noisy. After using right from the top-room state, the grid can show multiple visible 6 markers at once, possibly top room + lower-left + central 11 hub. In the lower 10-box alone, select/down/right appeared ineffective on repeat. Left/up sometimes seemed to link to a central lower 11 hub, but routing was noisy. In the central 11 hub, select sent state back to the lower 10-box; right from the central 11 hub returned to the top room; down from the hub earlier showed no visible change. Important correction: visible grids can alternate between a true three-marker state (top room + central hub + lower-left) and a hub+lower-left-only state. Current visible grid again appears to be the true three-marker state. Right, select, down, and repeated up probes have not shown visible change from this fuller state; left remains the best remaining direct probe.
